title: Projects a machine wants the fleet to infer
description: A machine whose admitted memory cannot infer the stale projects of a graph read publishes this request instead of computing them; a machine with headroom serves it by inferring the projects, whose records reach the requester through the project record exchange. The Policy numbers are measured: the parent holds 7.1 GB in one wave of 48 projects (7 121 MB, 7 172 MB) and 1.0 to 2.1 GB while it only verifies.
